exposure: Maternal pre-pregnancy insulin-dependent diabetic mellitus type 2
cohort: Two neonates born to mothers with pre-pregnancy insulin-dependent diabetic mellitus type 2 or suspected diabetes.
finding: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy in newborns can be the clinical expression of different underlying disorders, emphasizing the importance of reassessing maternal/family history, critically evaluating physical examination, and conducting regular cardiologic follow-up for correct differential diagnosis and prognosis.
